verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no Gusto feature for defining event-triggered rules or automations. Webhooks push events to a partner's application, which must then build and run its own business logic. That makes webhooks a developer building block, not a rules capability. Automatic payroll pre-generation is a schedule-driven behavior, not a user-defined event rule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
